title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(横谷哲也研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Yokotani Tetsuya)
keywords: Next generation network 2.Network virtualization 3.Reliable communication 4.Communication protocol 5.Traffic analysis
educationalGoal: [Theme] Next generation network architecture and its performance evaluation [Objectives] (1). Study on architecture of networks using network virtualization and their performance evaluation by traffic analysis and computer simulation based on the latest ICT trends (2). Through this study, enhancement of skill on network design and analysis
advice: [Research subjects] Research is focused on IoT and related areas. IoT: Internet of Things (1) Implement on IoT applications (2) Lightweight communication protocols for IoT (3) IoT Gateway (4) Traffic control for IoT traffic flows [Suggestion for study] This course includes enhancement of skills on writing of research reports and presentations for attending conference and workshop in addition to pure research. [Position of this course] This course is positioned as the final stage in the project design program. After reviewing basic knowledge in communication networks, this course undertakes that students derive high level research results through theoretical analysis and experiment.
requiredKnowledge: (1) Review of Preparatory Seminar for Design Project III in 6th team (2) Preparation study on Internet and related technologies (3) Colleting latest information on the ICT area (4) Recommendation of enrollment on The Institute of Electronics, Information and Communication Engineers (IEICE) for students who plans to continue their education into graduate school
